title: I want to display YOUR vibe coded demos!
author: bboingy
selftext:
I LOVE seeing all the cool stuff you guys get up to, especially the pretty and interactive stuff, so I made this site to host them for easy browsing and sharing.

It accepts an html file or a zip file with an index.html included.

I made the site with opus 5.5 (surprise surprise), and a few of the projects on there are mine and are also made with 5.5, usually with only 1 or 2 prompts (crazy how good it is).

So yeah, I'd love to see some more of your amazing projects at [webtoy.dev](http://webtoy.dev/)

Thanks creative ppl!
